# Install `empty-states` — Empty States — 404/500/403 + zero-data

> Configurable EmptyState composing the shadcn Empty primitive: kind presets 404 / 500 / 403 / no-results / empty-list / first-use with default lucide icon + copy, all overridable.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add empty-states
# alias: npx rr add empty-states
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `empty-state`, `404`, `500`, `403`, `error-page`, `no-results`, `onboarding`, `basics`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add empty-states`. Drop <EmptyState kind="no-results" /> into zero-data spots; wrap with <ErrorPage kind="404" /> in app/not-found.tsx and kind="500" in app/error.tsx. Every preset's icon/title/description/action overridable per use.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
